checkpoint_bytes.byte_semantics: logical bytes written for this committed checkpoint

hash_index_metadata_bytes.definition: Serialized immutable index bytes, including artifact hashes and metadata references.

G0.definition: Serialized payload bytes for artifact group G0.

GA.definition: Serialized payload bytes for artifact group GA.

GB.definition: Serialized payload bytes for artifact group GB.

GC.definition: Serialized payload bytes for artifact group GC.

GD.definition: Serialized payload bytes for artifact group GD.

GE.definition: Serialized payload bytes for artifact group GE.

GF.definition: Serialized payload bytes for artifact group GF.

GH.definition: Serialized payload bytes for artifact group GH.

total_committed_checkpoint_bytes.definition: Payload, index/metadata, and commit-record logical bytes written for this checkpoint.

artifact_construction_latency_s.definition: Build semantic artifact objects from the workflow snapshot.

commit_publication_latency_s.definition: Write, fsync, atomically publish, and directory-sync the commit record.

commit_record_construction_latency_s.definition: Construct and serialize the publication commit record.

save_timing.durability_semantics: Local payload, index, commit, and directories fsynced; no remote durability claim.

hashing_latency_s.definition: Compute payload and immutable-index integrity hashes.

immutable_payload_write_latency_s.definition: Write immutable payload and index bytes, excluding sync calls.

persistence_sync_latency_s.definition: Flush and fsync immutable payload/index files and their directory.

save_commit_latency_s.definition: Checkpoint invocation through durable commit publication on the configured backend.

serialization_latency_s.definition: Serialize all present semantic artifact payloads.

decision_evidence_deserialization_latenc.definition: Deserialize planner evidence groups not already loaded.

integrity_verification_latency_s.definition: Read referenced bytes and verify cryptographic hashes.

locate_candidate_commit_latency_s.definition: Locate and order candidate commit records.

recovery_total_latency_s.definition: Recovery invocation through reconstructed checkpoint availability.

recovery_validation_latency_s.definition: Locate, structure validation, integrity verification, and boundary selection.
